A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have tried to contribute to the discussion of how the social structure and social stratification have been changing in the post‐Yugoslav countries, and how the processes of social change and social stratification are related to the development of the economy and the political system in these countries.

we have tried to demonstrate how the war has changed the social structure and social stratification in Serbia, and that these developments have been related to the emergence of an illiberaldemocratic economy in the country.

we have tried to demonstrate the importance of a social perspective in understanding the war in the Balkans, and the importance of understanding war in the Balkan region as a process of social transformation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the war in the former Yugoslavia, as well as the wars in other parts of the world, should be analysed in the context of the social and economic processes in a given society.
